title: Datto or Veeam: Backup for Managed Service Providers vs In-House IT
excerpt: Datto is built around managed service providers protecting many clients; Veeam covers everything from small businesses to large enterprises. The deciding question is who you are backing up for.
verdict: Datto is a strong fit for MSPs that manage backup and business continuity for many client organisations from one place. Veeam is the better choice when you are protecting a single organisation, your own, and want flexible recovery options at any scale.
